Chromium CVE-2026-110136: Use after free
Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based). Microsoft 2026-Oct security update.

en.title: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based): Vulnerability in CVE-2026-110136
en.summary: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) is affected by a vulnerability involving a use after free flaw tracked as CVE-2026-110136.
en.impact: The sources do not provide detailed impact information beyond the use after free vulnerability.
en.fix: The sources do not state fixed versions.
checks: Check systems for Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) installations.
Verify the application version against the Microsoft 2026-Oct security update.
